jamb_records.GLAZED_DOOR: zero (a glazed DOOR is a door)

policy.physical_jamb: physical = true by positive source evidence (strip reveal side, or an ESTABLISHED band end CAPPED / ALIGNED_FREE_END / OPENING_JAMB); never a topology closure source; never a CONTINUOUS_WALL_FACE side
policy.consumption: only a physical jamb record may consume path length; a non-physical record is an OPENING_SIDE annotation and never shortens an edge
policy.conservation: per site: boundary = consumed by physical jambs + payable spans + excluded spans + withheld spans (checked)
resolution_order: physical class authority (a door is never a window)
fixes: V3-O1: non-physical opening-side records consumed continuous wall face
never: a non-physical record consuming wall contact
a topology closure as material, skirting or a jamb
SKIRTING_CONTINUITY_UNDER_WINDOW at a door-class glazed occurrence
a published quantity without a frozen, blind-tested policy

method.system: QP-06: hidden skirting + hidden profile on one payable path (US-08)
rules: 1 dry / internal tiled room -> skirting on all eligible real wall contact
2 wardrobes / joinery / furniture do not deduct
3 authorised duct faces at floor contact are eligible
4 normal window above floor -> skirting continues below (SKIRTING_CONTINUITY_UNDER_WINDOW)
5 full-height floor opening -> no skirting across
5b floor-reaching sliding glazed door -> zero across and zero jambs (a door)
6 installed door -> stop at opening, no jamb return
7 doorless opening -> physical side jambs included
11 only a physical jamb may replace wall contact; a continuous wall face stays payable

authority.windows: QORTUBA-NEW-SKIRTING-WINDOW-FLOOR-CONTACT-OWNER-001@v1 (supersedes QP-09 in scope) + QORTUBA-NEW-NORMAL-WINDOWS-ABOVE-FLOOR-OWNER-001@v1 (sill ~1.00 m, normal windows only)
authority.obstacle_faces: QORTUBA-NEW-BED-ROOM-DUCT-OWNER-001@v1 + owner 'all real walls' + rule-store section E
authority.column_faces: rule-store section E ('a column is not an opening')

opening_class_policy.binding: owner_facts.bind: revision + anchor + region + frame + every bound part fingerprint
opening_class_policy.resolution: physical class first (a door class is never a window); floor contact from the fact
never: a topology role or closure edit
an opening the fact does not bind
a transfer to another revision / project
